findings.current: आज उपयोग हुए अतिरिक्त चेक-इन: {used} में से {maximum}
findings.problem: Order reversed. In Hindi "X में से Y" means "Y of X", so "{used} में से {maximum}" renders 1-used-of-3 as "1 में से 3" (3 of 1). The user reads the quota the wrong way round. The value calls it used-out-of-max, but the numbers say the opposite.
findings.suggested: "आज उपयोग हुए अतिरिक्त चेक-इन: {maximum} में से {used}"
